'''Carl Mike Hardy Deactivate The Shield''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''Deactivate The Shield'''. [[Carl Mike Hardy]] posted it on 29 June 2000. It was listed under Battle of Endor closed format.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carl Mike Hardy]]
* '''Published:''' 29 June 2000 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Deactivate The Shield
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 RST Hardy LS 2000 Red32.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This deck is designed specifically for the new Battle Of Endor Closed Tournament format. You notice that there are cards found only in the Endor and Death Star II expansion (with a couple of cards found from the DS2 pre-constructed deck... Legal utility cards from other expansions). It's designed to quickly destroy the Endor Shield while developing a strong space force at Endor. If your opponent tries to play with the Death Star II, you'll be able to blow it away with Lando and Gold Squadron 1 reletively easily. Once the shield is gone and you've flipped your objective, you can now Force drain at your leasure on Endor. There's plenty of nice cards in here that will give the Dark a real head ache if it tries to battle you on the ground. If he doesn't, This Is Absolutely Right, Wookie Guide and Corporal Midge will really start to take their toll. Concentrate on blowing away the shield before you do anything. That 8 Force lose will really hurt.
